summary: The Collagen Co. is a Melbourne collagen and wellness e-commerce brand that went live on NetSuite in November 2025, created a CFO role, and hired a Financial Controller in March 2026 to run finance across Australia and NZ and support US expansion. Sonia Chambers has been Financial Controller since April 2026.
